prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE complete full-body static pose for a 2D fighting game.
REFERENCE 1 is the accepted character design, proportions and crisp dark-outline CEL-SHADED art style. REFERENCE 2 is the official costume/colour authority. Preserve the exact same RIBBIT in a JAX-SUIT: GREEN frog face with pale mint muzzle and pink round cheeks, dark violet half-closed upper eyelids on two enormous raised oval eyes, white rectangular grinning teeth. Lavender suit and hood with exactly TWO rabbit ears, hot pink bow on the ANATOMICAL LEFT ear, coral pink short overalls with exactly TWO yellow buttons and one FRONT pocket, two yellow gloves, two slender lavender-covered legs and two rounded LAVENDER covered feet. Head stays frog-shaped, not Jax or a human. Keep palette, head size and lanky limb proportions consistent with reference 1. The costume contains no tail, exposed green limbs, neck bow, weapon, extra eye motifs or accessories.
Only the POSE described below changes. Exactly one frog head, two arms with two yellow hands, two legs with two lavender feet. BOTH ear tips, all fingers and BOTH soles fully inside generous empty safety margins. Native facing SCREEN-RIGHT in a 2D side-view fighting camera with mild three-quarter visibility; keep anatomical bow side consistent, not mirrored. Crisp clean cel-shaded 2D cartoon, no plush texture, not 3D, not realistic. True transparent RGBA background, zero-alpha empty space outside silhouette. NO glow, aura, haze, floor, floor shadow, motion trails, text, ring, strap, props or extra characters. One character and one pose per image.
POSE: Defeated kneeling pose facing screen-right, harmless exhaustion. One knee on the imaginary ground, other foot planted ahead, torso hunched, head lowered but frog face visible toward RIGHT. One yellow hand rests on forward knee and the other hangs low. Both feet and two hands visible, both ears retained inside frame. No wounds, no other character, no ground plane.

observations: Défaite par épuisement : un genou posé, autre pied en avant, tête et torse abaissés, une main sur le genou.
Visage encore grimaçant/souriant selon l’identité Jax-Suit ; deux mains et deux pieds visibles, aucun membre supplémentaire ni blessure.
visualReview.scope: Official merchandise costume; original static game pose, no canonical episode certification.
